root_cause_label: Incorrect Legacy Source URL Knowledge + Spec-Violating Workaround
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent assumed POV-Ray 2.2 sources were distributed as zip/tgz under the 'Official/' path rather than as .TAR.Z under 'Official-2.2/', causing all download attempts to fail, then violated the build-from-source requirement by installing the system POV-Ray 3.7 package as a workaround.
t_err_evidence: Step 2 attempts to download 'povsrc22.zip', 'povuni22.tgz', 'povdoc22.zip' from '.../Old-Versions/Official/' — wrong filenames (should be POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z) and wrong directory (should be Official-2.2/). This unverified false premise about archive format and location is the decisive mistake.
t_commit_evidence: Step 12 explicitly installs 'apt-get install povray povray-includes' (POV-Ray 3.7), symlinking it to /usr/local/bin/povray and populating /app/povray-2.2 with 3.7 include files. This definitively abandons the source-build path and locks in a spec-violating workaround.
t_surface_evidence: Step 3 output shows 'curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 404' for all attempted URLs and produces only zero-byte files (povdoc22.zip, povsrc22.zip, povuni22.tgz), making the download failure clearly visible.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on an unverified assumption that POV-Ray 2.2 source archives were named povsrc22.zip/povuni22.tgz/povdoc22.zip in the 'Old-Versions/Official/' directory using zip/tgz format, when the actual files are POVSRC.TAR.Z/POVSCN.TAR.Z/POVDOC.TAR.Z in 'Old-Versions/Official-2.2/' using Unix compress (.Z) format. This false premise was never corrected throughout the trajectory.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3 shows 404 errors from every attempted URL and zero-byte downloaded files. Steps 4-11 show the same zero-byte results repeated across different mirrors, timestamps, and sources, clearly signaling the filenames/paths are wrong before the agent pivoted to the package workaround at step 12.
